page.layout: One page of text on the right (printed page 129); a fragment of the facing left page with marginal notes is visible at the far left edge, outside the text block, and is not transcribed as text. Running head "Δ I" at top centre. Main text in one column with Greek, Latin and German words; a few marginal references are in the text block itself.

main_text.p: Διπλόος ης, ὀη ἡ, ὁοv ἓν duplex, 1.Tim.5.17.
Διπλόω ω duplico. Fut.ὡσω. a.1.ἐδιπλωσα. a.1. imperat.διπλωσον ἀτω, Apoc.18.6. διπλώσα-τε. (2.pl. a.1. imperat.) αὐτῇ διπλα. P. διδι-πλωκα. P.pass. διδιπλωμαι.
Δὶς bis. Hinc est δι (sicut bi à Latino bis) quod in compositione rem geminam semper significat. plane, Juda v.12.
Διαζίζω dubito. Fut.άσω. (vel ἀξω.)P.διδισχκα. (vel διδιζχα.) a.1. ἐδιζασα, Matth.14.31.
Διάρμος ς ὁ ἡ anceps. ex δὶ pro δὶς bis, & σο-μα τος τὸ os. q.d. duorum orium, quia ensis utrimq; mordet, zweyschneidig / Heb.4. v.12.
Διακόσιοι αγ α bis mille, Marc.5.31.
Διυλίζω percolo, per colum transfundo. (ex Διὰ & υλίζω defaco. ὕλη ης ἡ materia, ligna, item faces, sordes.) F.διυλίσω. P.διυλυκα, Matth.23.24.
Διχάζω diffidere facio. F.άσω. a.1. ἐδιχασα. a.1. infin. διχάσαι, Matth.10.35. P.διδιχακα.

Διχοστασία ας ἡ diffensio proprie, quum in duas partes factiones secedunt, & suum quaq; locum seorsim habent, adeo, ut quorum animi inter se dissident, eorum corpora quoq; sint disjuncta. ex δίχα duplicter, bifariam, absq; separatim, quod est à δὶς bis & στάσις εως ἡ status, item factio. Them. ἱστημι, Rom.16.17.

page.notes: The left-page fragment and its marginal notes at the far left edge are cut off and largely illegible; they are not transcribed. Several Greek words are approximated and may contain errors; the German word "zweyschneidig" is printed in black letter.
